battle.name: 古巴獨立戰爭
battle.brief: 一八九五年二月二十四日東方省拜雷起義，古巴獨立戰爭開打；西班牙以二十萬大軍與速射後膛砲鎮壓，起義軍則以游擊與繳獲的滑膛前裝砲周旋，一八九八年美軍登陸、擊沉西班牙分艦隊，聖地牙哥才易手。卡面這件一八五〇年德製線膛前裝野砲，代表的正是被這一戰淘汰的前裝砲世代。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰雙方是西班牙王國與古巴起義軍，兩邊各自有一整套國家機器在運作。西班牙一方由哈瓦那的古巴總督府統治全島，總督兼陸軍總司令掌握島上全部守軍：正規軍由各城市的守備司令部率領，地方義勇民兵擔任護送、清鄉與巡邏，鄉村另有專門追捕起義者的游擊隊；海軍方面是駐紮古巴的海外艦隊，母港在哈瓦那，以封鎖線切斷起義軍的軍火來源，並在聖地牙哥與西恩富戈斯港佈設水雷與魚雷。島上還有一支特別的治安武力：西班牙治安民兵於一八九四年調入古巴，白人士兵連與黑人士兵分隊分開駐紮，專職城鎮巡邏與鄉村搜索，成為西班牙方面最難纏的武裝之一。起義軍一方以一八九二年成立的古巴革命黨為政治中樞；一八九五年九月六日至中旬，五個解放軍軍團代表在卡馬圭省希馬瓜尤集會，通過憲法並成立執政議會，由薩爾瓦多·西斯內羅斯任主席、巴托洛梅·馬索任副主席，軍隊則由最高統帥馬克西莫·戈梅斯統一編制為解放軍，東方省各縣另設指揮部由司令官分區作戰，安東尼奧·馬塞奧以副總司令身分率第二軍縱橫全島。第三方是美國：起初只是旁觀者與走私船的來源地，一八九八年四月起以國家身分正式開火；古巴流亡社群在美國東岸的約克城與基韋斯特建立援助網，承接偷運來的軍火船隊。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of Spain and the Cuban insurgents, each with a complete state machine working behind it. On the Spanish side, the Captaincy General of Cuba in Havana governed the whole island, and the governor-general, who also commanded the army, held every regular unit on it: the regulars were led by the garrison commands of the individual cities, locally recruited volunteer militia performed escort, pacification and patrol work, and separate bands of guerrillas were raised in the countryside to hunt down the insurgents. At sea stood the Overseas Squadron based in Havana, which ran a blockade to cut off the rebels' arms shipments and laid mines and torpedoes in the harbours of Santiago de Cuba and Guantánamo. One more Spanish formation on the island was unusual: the Guardia Civil, transferred to Cuba in 1894, was split into companies of white soldiers and detachments of black soldiers stationed apart, its duty being city patrol and countryside search, and it became one of the most troublesome armed bodies the Spanish side had. The insurgents were politically organised around the Cuban Revolutionary Party, founded in 1892; between 6 and mid-September 1895 the representatives of the five Liberation Army corps met at Jimaguayú in Camagüey, adopted a constitution and set up a Government Council, with Salvador Cisneros as president and Bartolomé Masó as vice-president, while the armed forces were unified by the general-in-chief Máximo Gómez as the Ejército Libertador, each district of Oriente having its own command under a commander, and Antonio Maceo, as lieutenant general, leading the Second Corps across the island. The third party was the United States: at first a bystander and the source of the smuggling ships, from April 1898 it fought as a state; the Cuban exile community built an aid network in New York and Key West on the American east coast, receiving the filibuster arms ships there.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩邊。起義軍這邊，何塞·馬蒂是整場戰爭的政治靈魂：一八九二年他參與創立古巴革命黨並擔任代表，一八九五年三月二十五日發表《蒙特克里斯蒂宣言》，宣示黑種人與白種人一同作戰、不傷害不反對戰爭的西班牙人、保護私人莊園，一八九五年四月十一日與馬克西莫·戈梅斯等五人在普拉伊塔斯登陸，五月十九日在多斯里奧斯戰死，被後世尊為獨立的使徒。馬克西莫·戈梅斯是最高統帥，這位多明尼加出生的前西班牙軍人把起義軍由東方省一路打到西部，策動一八九五年十月起的大舉進攻。安東尼奧·馬塞奧是青銅泰坦，一八九五年四月一日只帶二十二人於巴拉科阿登陸，率第二軍縱橫西部，年底完成著名的反向行軍，從西邊殺回東方，一八九六年十二月七日與侍從在哈瓦那省聖佩德羅莊園遭西班牙縱隊伏擊陣亡，侍從潘奇托即戈梅斯之子為護住屍體亦戰死；其兄何塞·馬塞奧同年六月在古雅貝拉一線陣亡。西班牙這邊，總督與陸軍總司令數度更替：加西亞·德·波拉維耶哈、馬丁內斯·坎波斯即修築阻隔線者、韋萊爾即下令實施再集中者，還有布蘭科；一八九八年聖地牙哥的防線由恩里克·利斯特主持，城的守備由托拉爾准將負責，艦隊由帕斯夸爾·塞爾韋拉率領，最終全艦在七月三日被美軍擊沉。美國方面，總統麥金萊、國務卿海伊、海軍部長朗、艦隊司令桑普森與謝利、陸軍沙夫特與惠勒指揮一八九八年的登陸作戰。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall on both sides of the line. On the insurgent side José Martí was the political soul of the whole war: he helped found the Cuban Revolutionary Party in 1892 and served as its delegate, issued the Manifesto of Montecristi on 25 March 1895 declaring that the war would be waged by black and white men alike, that Spaniards who did not oppose the war should be spared, and that private property was to be respected, landed at Playitas with Máximo Gómez and four others on 11 April 1895, and was killed at Dos Ríos on 19 May, which is why he is venerated as the Apostle of Independence. Máximo Gómez was the general-in-chief: a former Spanish officer born in the Dominican Republic, he carried the rebellion from Oriente all the way to the west of the island and launched the great advance that began in October 1895. Antonio Maceo was the bronze titan: he landed at Baracoa with only twenty-two men on 1 April 1895, led the Second Corps across the west of the island, and at the end of the year completed the famous counter-march, riding from the west back to the east; on 7 December 1896 he and his escort were caught by a Spanish column in an ambush at the farm of San Pedro in Havana province and were killed, his aide-de-camp Panchito, the son of Gómez, dying as well while covering the body; his brother José Maceo fell in the same year at Guayabera. On the Spanish side the captain-general changed hands repeatedly: García de Polavieja, Martínez-Campos, the man who built the trocha, Weyler, the man who ordered the reconcentration, and finally Blanco; in 1898 the defence line of Santiago was directed by Enrique Líster, the city was held by Brigadier General Toral, and the fleet was commanded by Pascual Cervera, whose squadron was destroyed by the American navy on 3 July. On the American side President McKinley, Secretary of State Hay, Secretary of the Navy Long, admirals Sampson and Schley and generals Shafter and Wheeler directed the landings of 1898.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是德國一八五〇年前後的線膛前裝野砲，設計代號前裝野戰砲，國別標記德國，屬陸軍裝備。它的技術要點只有一個：膛線。同樣一包藥量裝進有膛線的砲膛，藥柱能完整推向砲膛前端，彈丸沿膛線旋轉出膛，射程與精度同時上一個臺階，砲兵第一次可以在射程上壓過步兵。放到一八九五年的古巴，這件武器卻已經是過時世代：西班牙陸軍在一八九〇年代已全面換裝鋼製後膛速射砲，古巴起義軍既無力自造，也無從取得這種線膛砲，島上真正在流的，是西班牙軍火庫裡那批十八、十九世紀的青銅滑膛前裝砲——起義軍繳獲後拆掉原砲架，臨時做木製砲架，或索性把砲身固定在路邊與山口當固定砲位，射擊完不便轉移，一遇雨季泥濘就難以行軍。所以這張卡在戰役裡的位置是缺席的技術：它代表起義軍最需要、卻始終得不到的那一代砲兵裝備，也是西班牙殖民當局在一八九五年之前就已經淘汰的舊世代火器。實際戰場上雙方的裝備差距極大：西班牙正規軍使用七毫米毛瑟一八九三式無煙藥栓動步槍與貝雷塔一八九二年式卡槍，砲兵裝備速射後膛砲，駐港艦隊提供大口徑海軍砲與水雷魚雷；起義軍步槍多為美製溫徹斯特、馬林、雷明頓，另有大量左輪手槍與砍刀，靠襲取西班牙軍需補充彈藥，幾乎沒有制式砲兵，也沒有機槍。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a German rifled muzzle-loading field gun of about 1850, designated a muzzle-loading field gun, marked as German, in the land category. It has exactly one technical point to make: rifling. The same charge of powder, fired from a rifled bore, drives the powder column properly forward, the shot leaves the muzzle spinning along the rifling, and range and accuracy rise together, so that artillery can for the first time outrange infantry. Set in Cuba in 1895, however, this weapon is already of a superseded generation: the Spanish army had by the 1890s gone over to steel breech-loading quick-firing guns, the Cuban insurgents could neither manufacture nor obtain a rifled field gun, and what actually flowed on the island was the bronze smoothbore muzzle-loading stock of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries kept in the Spanish arsenals. The insurgents stripped these of their original carriages, built wooden ones in a hurry, or simply fixed the barrels by the roadside and at mountain passes as static guns; once fired they could not be moved easily, and in the muddy rains of the wet season they could hardly be marched at all. The card's position in this campaign is therefore an absent technology: it stands for the one generation of artillery equipment the insurgents most needed and never got, and equally for the old-generation ordnance the Spanish colonial government had already retired before 1895. The gap in equipment on the actual battlefield was enormous. Spanish regulars carried the 7 mm Mauser M1893 bolt-action rifle on smokeless powder and the Beretta Model 1892 carbine, their artillery was armed with modern quick-firing breech-loaders, and the squadron in harbour supplied heavy naval guns together with mines and torpedoes. The insurgent muskets were mostly American-made Winchester, Marlin and Remington, with a large supply of revolvers and machetes; ammunition was taken from Spanish depots in raids, and they had almost no regular artillery at all and no machine guns whatsoever.
tactics: 起義軍的整套打法是游擊，不是會戰。武器禁運令讓他們沒有火砲、沒有電報、沒有後方醫療，於是全靠小股隊伍、馬匹與道路地形做文章：一八九五年二月二十四日東方省拜雷一帶起義時，起義者同時熄燈作為全島起義的信號；四月一日馬塞奧僅帶二十二人自巴拉科阿登陸，轉入山區，靠襲擊西班牙縱隊與奪取軍械迅速壯大。馬塞奧與戈梅斯兩路大縱隊自一八九五年十月起西進，八個月內攻下二十二座城鎮，硬闖西班牙的阻隔線——那是沿胡卡羅至莫龍鐵路修的八十公里長、寬二百米、每四百米一段十二米高木樁加鐵絲網並埋設陷阱的帶狀工事，起義軍靠夜間剪斷鐵路、小股穿過的方式突破。西班牙的對策是韋萊爾一八九六年十月二十一日頒布的再集中令：要求鄉村居民與牲畜八日內撤入軍隊控制的安全區，斷絕起義軍的糧食與徵集來源；同時以正規縱隊沿道路搜剿、以鄉村游擊隊跟蹤。防守方的堡壘才是關鍵：一八九五年七月十七日馬塞奧攻聖胡安山一線被西班牙速射砲擋回，一八九八年七月一日美軍在聖胡安山與埃爾卡內伊碰到的仍是同樣的西班牙火砲與壕溝線，只是這次面對的是美軍五吋三吋砲與四挺加特林機槍。海戰裡，港內舊砲、水雷與魚雷完全擋不住塞爾韋拉分艦隊衝出港口：阿方索·德·奧昆多號的主砲後膛機構故障炸死了整組砲手，維斯凱亞號被美軍巡洋艦布魯克林號連中兩百發。
tacticsEn: The whole method of the insurgents was guerrilla war, not set-piece battle. The ban on arms left them without guns, without a telegraph and without a rear-area hospital, so everything rested on small columns, horses and the terrain along the roads. When the rising began in the Baire area of Oriente on 24 February 1895, the insurgents put out the lights as a signal for the general uprising across the island; on 1 April Maceo landed at Baracoa with only twenty-two men, took to the mountains and grew quickly by attacking Spanish columns on the march and seizing their weapons and ammunition. Two great columns under Maceo and Gómez moved west from October 1895, took twenty-two towns within eight months and broke through the Spanish trocha, a belt eighty kilometres long and two hundred metres wide built along the railway from Júcaro to Morón, with twelve-metre posts and wire every four hundred metres and traps laid in the likely approaches; the rebels got through by cutting the railway at night and filtering across in small parties. Spain's answer was the reconcentration decree issued by Weyler on 21 October 1896, requiring rural residents and their livestock to be brought within eight days into the security zones held by troops, so as to cut the insurgents off from food and from recruitment, while regular columns swept the roads and rural guerrilla bands kept on their heels. The fortified positions were the decisive point: on 17 July 1895 Maceo was checked by Spanish quick-firing guns when he attacked the San Juan line, and on 1 July 1898 the Americans at San Juan Hill and El Caney met the same Spanish guns and the same trench system, only now facing American 5.3-inch pieces and four Gatling guns. At sea the old coastal guns, the mines and the torpedoes in the harbour could not stop Cervera's squadron from trying to run out of port: a faulty breech on the Almirante Oquendo killed an entire gun crew, and the Vizcaya took some two hundred hits from the American cruiser Brooklyn.
data: 時間線可以排出來：一八九五年二月二十四日拜雷起義，四月一日馬塞奧在巴拉科阿登陸，四月十一日馬蒂與戈梅斯在普拉伊塔斯登陸，五月十九日馬蒂陣亡，七月十七日聖胡安山一役起義軍受挫，九月六日至中旬希馬瓜尤立憲，十月大舉進攻西部、二十二座城鎮在八個月內易手，一八九六年十月二十一日再集中令頒布，一八九六年十二月七日馬塞奧陣亡，一八九七年八月三十日拉圖納斯守軍投降、十月十日拉亞亞第二次制憲會議、十二月韋萊爾被召回，一八九八年二月十五日緬因號在哈瓦那港爆炸沉沒、二百六十名艦員陣亡，四月二十五日美西開戰，六月二十二至二十四日美軍在代基里與錫博尼登陸，六月二十四日拉斯瓜西馬斯交戰，七月一日埃爾卡內伊與聖胡安山同日開打，七月三日塞爾韋拉分艦隊在聖地牙哥外海被全殲、七月十六日聖地牙哥投降，八月十二日簽訂和約議定書，十二月十日《巴黎條約》簽字。兵力方面：西班牙在島上的部隊一八九五年初約八萬（正規軍二萬、民兵六萬），同年十二月底正規軍增至九萬八千四百一十二人、民兵六萬三千，全戰爭自本土送往古巴的兵員合計約二十二萬，被稱為二次大戰前橫渡大西洋的最大規模軍隊；到一八九八年島上西班牙軍隊已達二十萬上下。起義軍方面沒有可靠總數，但一八九八年初已控制全島三分之二領土，一八九七年八月三十日以約三千人逼降拉圖納斯守軍（該地原有一千餘名裝備齊全的守軍）。行軍數據：馬塞奧與戈梅斯兩路大縱隊在一八九五年十月至年底的西進與反攻中，騎行或徒步超過一千英里，用了九十六天。物資線的數字最說明問題：一八九五年六月十一日至一八九七年十一月三十日之間，由境外偷運軍火物資的六十次嘗試只有一次成功，二十八艘在美國領海被攔截，五艘被美國海軍在海上攔截，四艘被西班牙海軍攔截，兩艘遇海難沉沒，一艘因風暴折返。戰役另一端：一八九八年七月一日聖胡安山之戰，美軍沙夫特第五軍團約一萬五千人，攻守兵力比約十六比一；七月三日聖地牙哥海戰中西班牙一方三百四十三人陣亡、一百五十一人受傷，美方救起一千八百八十九名西班牙水兵，美軍自身僅兩人死傷。
dataEn: The chronology can be set out. The rising began at Baire on 24 February 1895; Maceo landed at Baracoa on 1 April; Martí and Gómez landed at Playitas on 11 April; Martí was killed on 19 May; the rebels were checked at San Juan on 17 July; the constituent assembly met at Jimaguayú between 6 and mid-September; the great advance to the west began in October and took twenty-two towns within eight months; the reconcentration decree was issued on 21 October 1896; Maceo was killed on 7 December 1896; Las Tunas surrendered on 30 August 1897; a second constituent assembly met at La Yaya on 10 October 1897; Weyler was recalled in December; the Maine exploded and sank in Havana harbour on 15 February 1898 with 260 of her crew killed; war was declared on 25 April; the Americans landed at Daiquirí and Siboney between 22 and 24 June; Las Guásimas was fought on 24 June; El Caney and San Juan Hill were both fought on 1 July; Cervera's squadron was annihilated off Santiago on 3 July and Santiago surrendered on 16 July; the peace protocol was signed on 12 August and the Treaty of Paris on 10 December. On numbers of men: the Spanish forces on the island stood at about 80,000 in early 1895, of which 20,000 were regulars and 60,000 militia; by the end of December the regulars had risen to 98,412 with 63,000 volunteers, and roughly 220,000 troops in all were sent from the mainland to Cuba over the course of the war, the largest army to cross the Atlantic until the Second World War; by 1898 the Spanish forces on the island numbered around two hundred thousand. No reliable total exists for the insurgents, but by the beginning of 1898 they held two thirds of the island's territory, and on 30 August 1897 a force of about three thousand compelled the surrender of Las Tunas, which had been held by over a thousand well-armed and well-supplied men. On distances: the two great columns under Maceo and Gómez covered more than a thousand miles, on horseback and on foot, in ninety-six days during the westward advance and the counter-march of late 1895. The figures on supply are the most telling of all: between 11 June 1895 and 30 November 1897, of sixty attempts to smuggle arms and supplies into the country only one succeeded; twenty-eight ships were intercepted within United States territory, five were intercepted at sea by the United States Navy, four by the Spanish Navy, two were wrecked and one was driven back to port by storm. On the other end of the war: at San Juan Hill on 1 July 1898 Shafter's Fifth Corps numbered about fifteen thousand men against a sixteen to one odds; and in the naval action off Santiago on 3 July the Spanish lost 343 killed and 151 wounded, the Americans picked up 1,889 Spanish sailors from the water, and suffered two killed or wounded themselves.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因，要從一八七八年之後那段補償性休戰說起。十年戰爭以西班牙承諾給予古巴自治的條約收場，但承諾從未兌現：一八九五年古巴已實行自治選舉，議會卻連自己的總督都無權任命，議會的權限可以被總督府一紙公文取消。改革的路也在本土堵死：一八九三年阿方索·莫拉提出的古巴與波多黎各自治方案在一八九四年被推翻，白人自治派與馬蒂那一派就此決裂。馬蒂等人於是在一八九二年另組古巴革命黨，決定以武裝起義推翻西班牙統治，並把它稱為必要之戰：一八九五年三月他在蒙特克里斯蒂發表宣言，宣示黑種人與白種人一同作戰、不傷害不反對戰爭的西班牙人、保護私人莊園，把起義定義成全島的全民戰爭。直接引爆點是軍火。革命黨從美國偷運軍火，一八九四年十二月二十五日拉貢達、阿爾馬迪斯與巴拉科阿三船自佛羅里達費爾南迪納海灘出發，其中兩艘在次年一月被美國當局扣查，船上軍火清單暴露，起義的時間表隨之曝光。西班牙當局加緊緝查，革命黨於是把起義提前，二月二十四日東方省拜雷一帶同時開火，獨立戰爭就這樣打開。
causeEn: The origins of this war run back to the compensating truce that followed 1878. The Ten Years' War ended on a Spanish promise of autonomy for Cuba, and the promise was never kept: by 1895 Cuba held autonomous elections, yet its assembly could not so much as appoint its own governor, and its powers could be cancelled by a single decree from the Captaincy General. The road of reform was blocked in the mother country as well: the plan for Cuban and Puerto Rican autonomy put forward by Alfonso Maura in 1893 was overthrown in 1894, and the white autonomist faction split from Martí's. Martí and his circle therefore formed the Cuban Revolutionary Party in 1892 and resolved to bring the colonial power down by armed insurrection, calling it the necessary war; in March 1895 he issued the Manifesto of Montecristi, declaring that the war would be waged by black and white men alike, that Spaniards who did not object to the war should be spared and that private property was to be protected, defining the rising as a war of the whole nation. The immediate trigger was arms. The party was smuggling weapons in from the United States, and on 25 December 1894 the Lagonda, the Almadis and the Baracoa sailed from Fernandina Beach in Florida; two of them were seized by the American authorities in January, the cargo manifests exposed the plan, and with them the timetable of the rising. Spanish searches tightened, the party brought the date forward, and on 24 February the guns went off simultaneously in the Baire area of Oriente. That is how the war of independence was opened.
impact: 這場戰爭的影響，首先是把西班牙在美洲的殖民制度送進墳墓。古巴的抵抗與美國的市場、安全與軍事考慮，最終在一八九八年合流成美西戰爭：西班牙丟掉古巴，又在菲律賓與波多黎各受挫，一八九八年十二月十日《巴黎條約》簽訂時，它在美洲的版圖只剩下一座群島與一個島嶼。一八九八年一月底哈瓦那發生西班牙保皇派騷亂，報館印刷機被砸，美國總領事電報華盛頓稱美國人生命受威脅，戰列艦緬因號於是開入哈瓦那港，二月十五日爆炸沉沒，二百六十名艦員陣亡；美西兩國的調查結論從水雷炸沉變成船內爆炸，事故原因至今沒有定論，但輿論早已認定西班牙理虧。配合這一事件的新聞渲染把華盛頓推向開戰，參議員雷德菲爾德·普羅克特三月十七日那篇演說是最關鍵的轉折。技術層面的教訓更耐嚼：西班牙守軍有速射後膛砲、七毫米毛瑟槍與加固要塞，卻擋不住美軍的加特林機槍與艦砲；重砲與固定砲台在無煙藥與後膛時代已經改寫，防守方在這條路上整整落後一代。西屬美洲其他殖民地的學生也學會了同一課：海地、委內瑞拉之後，古巴示範了以流動戰、封鎖與外資介入拖垮帝國的辦法，這條路在一八九九年被菲律賓照走一遍。古巴自己付出的代價則在往後：起義軍的裝備長期靠突擊繳獲維持，起義初期能用的步槍多是美製溫徹斯特與馬林，加特林機槍一支都沒有；到一八九八年初，起義軍雖控制全島三分之二領土，卻仍然沒有足以攻城的重砲，也沒有海軍，一九〇二年古巴在美國保護下取得的形式獨立，與這份火力差距直接相關。
impactEn: The effect of this war was first of all to bury the Spanish colonial system in the Americas. The Cuban resistance and American commercial, security and military considerations finally converged in 1898 into the Spanish-American War: Spain lost Cuba and was checked in the Philippines and Puerto Rico, and when the Treaty of Paris was signed on 10 December 1898 its American empire had come down to an archipelago and a single island. At the end of January 1898 a riot by Spanish loyalists in Havana smashed the printing presses of the local papers, the United States consul general cabled Washington that the lives of Americans were in danger, and the battleship Maine was sent into Havana harbour, where she exploded and sank on 15 February with 260 of her crew killed. The American and Spanish investigations moved from a mine detonation to an internal explosion, and the cause has never been settled, but public opinion had long since convicted Spain. The journalism that surrounded the incident pushed Washington towards war, and the speech of Senator Redfield Proctor on 17 March was the decisive turn. The technical lessons are the more durable. Spanish defenders had quick-firing breech-loaders, 7 mm Mauser rifles and reinforced works, and could not keep out Gatling guns and naval gunfire; heavy guns and fixed emplacements had been rewritten by the age of smokeless powder and the breech, and the defence was a full generation behind on that road. The other students of Spain's American colonies learned the same lesson: after Haiti and Venezuela, Cuba demonstrated how to wear an empire down with fluid war, blockade and foreign money, and the Philippines walked the same road in 1899. Cuba paid a price of its own, visible later on: the insurgents' equipment depended for years on what they could capture, their early muskets were largely American Winchester and Marlin, they had not a single Gatling gun, and even in early 1898, holding two thirds of the island, they had neither the heavy guns needed to take a city nor a navy of their own, which is directly connected with the form of independence Cuba obtained in 1902 under American protection.
result: 結果要分軍事前後看。一八九五至一八九七這一段，起義軍用三年時間贏得半壁江山：阻隔線被剪斷，二十二座城鎮易手，到一八九八年初起義軍控制全島三分之二土地；韋萊爾的再集中政策沒有換來治安，反而把鄉村推向起義軍一邊，拉圖納斯這樣有千餘名裝備齊全守軍的據點，也在一八九七年八月三十日被迫投降。但西班牙始終沒有被趕下島，起義軍也始終沒有能正面攻下聖地牙哥：一八九五年七月十七日聖胡安山一役的失敗說明，沒有制式砲兵就啃不動加固的高地工事。真正的終結者是美國：一八九八年六月下旬美軍在代基里與錫博尼登陸，六月二十四日拉斯瓜西馬斯交戰，七月一日埃爾卡內伊與聖胡安山同日開打，最後七月三日塞爾韋拉分艦隊在衝出港口時被美軍戰列艦與巡洋艦全殲，七月十六日聖地牙哥守軍投降，八月十二日美西簽訂和約議定書，十二月十日《巴黎條約》確認西班牙放棄古巴，一八九九年古巴臨時政府成立，一九〇二年古巴在美國保護下取得形式獨立，卡利斯托·加西亞出任首任總統。對卡面這件前裝野砲而言，這場戰爭還有一層技術註腳：它所代表的前裝砲與滑膛砲在古巴的最後用途，是被起義軍從西班牙軍火庫裡繳獲、固定在路邊與山口充當固定砲位；等到西班牙自己用上速射後膛砲、美軍帶來五吋砲與加特林機槍，這一世代武器便徹底退場，起義軍與西班牙之間那道火力世代的牆也一直留到一九〇二年。
resultEn: The outcome reads on two levels. In the phase from 1895 to 1897 the insurgents won half the island in three years: the trocha was cut, twenty-two towns changed hands, and by the beginning of 1898 they held two thirds of the territory; Weyler's reconcentration bought no security and pushed the countryside towards the insurgents instead, and Las Tunas, with more than a thousand well-equipped defenders, was compelled to surrender on 30 August 1897. But Spain was never driven off the island, and the insurgents never took Santiago by assault: the reverse at San Juan on 17 July 1895 showed that without regular artillery they could not chew through fortified heights. The real finisher was the United States. In late June 1898 the Americans landed at Daiquirí and Siboney, fought at Las Guásimas on 24 June, fought at El Caney and San Juan Hill on 1 July, and on 3 July destroyed Cervera's squadron as it tried to run out of port, the battleships and cruisers leaving nothing afloat. Santiago surrendered on 16 July, the peace protocol was signed on 12 August, and the Treaty of Paris of 10 December confirmed Spain's renunciation of Cuba; a Cuban provisional government was formed in 1899, and in 1902 Cuba obtained formal independence under American protection with Calixto García as its first president. For the muzzle-loading field gun on the card there is a technical footnote as well: the last use of the muzzle-loading and smoothbore artillery it represents in Cuba was to be captured by the insurgents from the Spanish depots and set up by the roadside and at mountain passes as static guns; once Spain had its quick-firing breech-loaders and the Americans brought 5-inch pieces and Gatling guns, that generation of weapon left the field for good, and the wall of a firing-generation gap between the insurgents and Spain was still standing in 1902.
